summary: OpenAI published an internal economic research report quantifying how Codex agentic usage has grown and displaced ChatGPT as the primary AI tool across every department at the company over the past year.

mechanisms.reason: The document reports company-wide, measured displacement of chatbot interactions by autonomous, parallel, long-horizon agent usage across all departments.
mechanisms.quote: By June 2026, users at the 99th percentile regularly generated more than 60 hours of Codex agent turns per day, distributed across multiple, parallel agents.

mechanisms.reason: The report documents order-of-magnitude increases in output tokens generated per user/department as agentic usage scales.
mechanisms.quote: Research saw the biggest jump: by June 2026, median use was 56 times higher than in November 2025.

practices.reason: The task-horizon estimation methodology (LLM-as-judge over transcripts) is a measurement technique a team could adapt to gauge agent task complexity, though it is described only briefly and tied to OpenAI's own data.
practices.quote: Task horizon is estimated using an LLM-as-judge with access to Codex transcripts.

notable_reason: It provides rare quantified internal evidence of exponential, cross-departmental agentic workflow adoption displacing chatbot interactions, a concrete data point for the agentic-shift thesis.
